title: Incorrect reserve assignment leads to reserve mismatch and fund mismanagement
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Upon handling a failed migration in the `g8keepBondingCurve::_handleMigrationFailed` function, the reserves for ETH and tokens are incorrectly assigned.
